title: ZIP-8/Ag-based size-selective SERS nanoplatform for ultrasensitive urea detection in milk samples: effects of analyte molecular dimensions on adsorption capacity and sensing performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,4915-4925
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07695H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Dao Thi Nguyet Nga, Quan Doan Mai, Linh Ho Thuy Nguyen, Tan Le Hoang Doan, Vu Thi Kim Oanh, Ta Ngoc Bach, Vu Dinh Lam, Ha Anh Nguyen, Anh-Tuan Le
Urea, methylene blue and Congo red were employed to investigate SERS performance of a ZIP-8/Ag heterostructure. Small dimensions allowed urea to be adsorbed into ZIP-8 framework, leading to enhancement in its SERS signal while the others were not.
